title: Hearty Italian Pasta Risotto
description: A winey, flaky, one-pot Italian dish featuring fresh basil, made with lacto-vegetarian friendly ingredients and cooked to perfection using sous-vide techniques. This dish is perfect for a cozy dinner night.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the Arborio rice and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the white wine and cook until the liquid is almost completely absorbed, stirring constantly.
Add 1/2 cup of the vegetable broth to the rice and cook, stirring constantly, until the liquid is almost completely absorbed.
Repeat the process, adding the broth in 1/2 cup increments, and waiting for it to be absorbed before adding more.
After 20 minutes of cooking, stir in the grated Grana Padano cheese.
Season with salt to taste, then stir in the chopped fresh basil.
Transfer the saucepan to a sous-vide water bath set to 180 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook for an additional 10 minutes, then serve hot.
